decisions.rationale: Across the reviewed internal contexts and the three source headings, முன் functions compositionally as the ordinary relational word 'before/in front of' linking phonological or morphological environments. The grammatical rule is technical, but the exact surface form itself is not used as a standalone grammatical technical term.
decisions.review_notes: The source-heading appearances உயிரீற்று முன் வல்லினம், மெய்யீற்றின் முன் உயிர், and மெய்யீற்றின் முன் மெய் are treated as relational syntax inside technical headings, not termhood for முன் itself.

decisions.rationale: Nannūl uses உயிர் technically for the vowel class and vowel position in explicit letter/punarcci contexts, including மெய் உயிர் contrasts and உயிர்-initial/final environments. The same exact form also has non-technical living-being/life senses, so acceptance is context-bounded rather than global.
decisions.review_notes: The heading மெய்யீற்றின் முன் உயிர் further supports the vowel sense. No claim is made that every occurrence of உயிர் is technical.

decisions.rationale: The source explicitly makes எண் an எழுத்து இயல் topic and நூற்பா 57 lists it among the grammatical dimensions to be treated. Other contexts use எண் in grammatical classifications involving numeral forms, while several reviewed occurrences are ordinary counting/enumerative uses; acceptance is therefore context-specific.
decisions.review_notes: Heading எண் (58–61) is source-supported metalanguage. Remaining unclassified occurrences are not automatically forced into either sense.

decisions.rationale: The exact form ய is repeatedly used as an explicitly enumerated Tamil letter/consonant symbol and as a member of phonological environments; the source heading ய ர ழ வீறு independently confirms its metalinguistic letter use.

Nannūl explicitly defines and organizes வேற்றுமை as a case system in பெயரியல் and uses the form technically in case/punarcci and syntactic descriptions. நூற்பா 451 instead uses the ordinary sense 'difference/distinction', so the accepted grammatical sense is bounded to the documented technical contexts.
decisions.review_notes: Source heading வேற்றுமை governing 291–319 is direct internal evidence for technical termhood.

decisions.rationale: ர is repeatedly treated as an exact Tamil letter/consonant symbol in letter classification, ending conditions, phonological environments, and the source heading ய ர ழ வீறு.

உருபு is used systematically for grammatical/morphological markers, especially case-related forms, and occurs in explicit source headings on உருபு புணர்ச்சி. The reviewed contexts show it functioning as named grammatical metalanguage rather than ordinary lexical usage.
decisions.review_notes: Category morphology is used as the broad analytical bucket; several occurrences are specifically case-marker contexts.

decisions.rationale: ழ is explicitly used as a Tamil consonant/letter symbol in classification and phonological environments, including the source heading ய ர ழ வீறு.

மெய் is clearly used as the consonant class and in consonantal grammatical environments, including the source heading மெய்யீற்றின் முன் மெய். The same exact form is non-technical in நூற்பா 444, where it participates in a bodily/sensory enumeration, so acceptance is context-bounded.
decisions.review_notes: The governed heading context at 206 reinforces the consonantal sense even though the body uses the compounded form மெய்முன் rather than standalone மெய்.

decisions.rationale: வினை functions repeatedly as grammatical metalanguage for verbal/action categories and is reinforced by the source heading முற்று வினை. Its reviewed uses participate directly in word-class, imperative, verbal, and particle descriptions.
decisions.review_notes: The heading-context record 323 is reviewed as evidence for the source heading முற்று வினை; the standalone token is not repeated in that body.

decisions.rationale: பெயர் is used technically for noun/name categories across எழுத்து, பதவியல், பெயரியல், and verbal descriptions. The source heading பெயர் and explicit பெயர்ச் சொல் contexts support grammatical metalanguage, although the exact form spans related naming and noun senses.
decisions.review_notes: The analytical category noun captures the dominant word-class use; some எழுத்து இயல் uses concern grammatical naming/class labels rather than nounhood narrowly.

decisions.rationale: முற்று is explicitly established by the source heading முற்று வினை and used in grammatical contrasts with எச்சம் and in finite-verbal descriptions. Its use in இடையியல் may represent a related but distinct grammatical sense, so acceptance does not assert one uniform meaning across all occurrences.
decisions.review_notes: Category verb is anchored in the explicit முற்று வினை section; additional grammatical senses can be refined later without changing the exact-form decision.

decisions.rationale: சொல் is repeatedly used as grammatical metalanguage for a word/expression and appears in source headings பெயர்ச் சொல் and வினைச் சொல். In நூற்பா 40, however, the exact form is the ordinary imperative 'say', so the accepted technical sense is explicitly separated from that non-term occurrence.
decisions.review_notes: Record 320 is governed by the heading வினைச் சொல்; the exact standalone token is in the heading rather than the body.

decisions.rationale: Nannūl explicitly names இடைநிலை as a grammatical topic and defines it in பதவியல் as an intervening component between பகுதி and விகுதி. The same exact form also participates in the technical பொருள்கோள் expression இடைநிலை மொழி, demonstrating multiple grammatical senses rather than ordinary lexical use.
decisions.review_notes: Category morphology reflects the explicit பதவியல் definition; the பொருள்கோள் use is retained as a separate grammatical sense rather than merged semantically.

decisions.rationale: சாரியை is explicitly named and described as a grammatical/morphological element in பதவியல் and உருபு புணரியல், with a dedicated source heading சாரியை. Reviewed uses consistently function as technical metalanguage.

பாயிரம் is explicitly defined and discussed as prefatory textual matter within Nannūl's own grammatical pedagogy, including its contents, function, and who may compose it. It is therefore source-supported grammatical/textual metalanguage.

பகுதி is explicitly named as a morphological component in பதவியல், receives its own source heading, and is defined in நூற்பா 134; the பெயரியல் use likewise treats it as a grammatical component of a name-form.

The source gives மாத்திரை its own எழுத்து இயல் heading and நூற்பா 99 explicitly states letter/sound duration values in மாத்திரை. In நூற்பா 321 the exact form instead functions restrictively ('merely/only'), so that occurrence is separated from the technical measure sense.
decisions.review_notes: Acceptance is for the measured-duration grammatical sense demonstrated in எழுத்து இயல்; it does not convert every occurrence of மாத்திரை into that sense.

decisions.rationale: வல்லினம் is explicitly defined as the six-letter class க ச ட த ப ற and is then used consistently as a phonological class in punarcci rules; the source heading உயிரீற்று முன் வல்லினம் reinforces the technical category.
decisions.review_notes: Record 165 is the governed context for the heading உயிரீற்று முன் வல்லினம்; the heading carries the exact token while the body enumerates the affected consonants.

decisions.rationale: The source heading வருமொழித் தகர நகரத் திரிபு uses திரிபு explicitly for a conditioned sound/form change, and பெயரியல் also uses the exact form in a grammatical statement about உருபு திரிபு. The form also has a broader variation sense in the நூல்-history context, so the sound-process category is context-specific rather than exhaustive.
decisions.review_notes: Record 237 is governed by the source heading containing திரிபு; the exact standalone token is heading evidence rather than body text. The occurrence in 8 is retained as a broader variation sense and is not classified further in this batch.

decisions.rationale: Nannūl explicitly defines பதம் as a meaning-bearing unit, divides it into பகாப்பதம் and பகுபதம், and reuses the exact form in grammatical inventories and உருபு-related rules.
decisions.review_notes: The source heading பதம் (128–133) and the explicit definition at 128 provide direct internal term evidence.

decisions.rationale: The bound exact form வேற்றுமைப் consistently carries the grammatical case sense in technical compounds such as வேற்றுமைப் பொருள் and வேற்றுமைப் புணர்ப்பு across punarcci contexts.
decisions.review_notes: This is an exact bound/attributive surface form of the already reviewed case term வேற்றுமை; it is retained independently rather than silently merged.

decisions.rationale: Nannūl gives வினையெச்சம் a dedicated source heading and explicit verbal classification/definition, and uses the exact form in both வினையியல் and punarcci discussion.
decisions.review_notes: Nūṟpā 342 defines the category under the heading வினையெச்சம்; the body uses the segmented form வினையெச் சம்மே.

decisions.rationale: விகுதி is explicitly listed as a component of பகுபதம், receives its own heading, and is enumerated through verbal/name endings in பதவியல்.

The exact bound form பொதுப் functions compositionally as the ordinary modifier 'general/common' inside technical expressions such as பொதுப் பாயிரம் and பொதுப் பெயர்; the reviewed evidence does not establish it as an independent grammatical technical term.
decisions.review_notes: Technical compounds containing பொதுப் remain meaningful; rejection concerns independent exact-form termhood only.

decisions.rationale: போலி is named as an எழுத்து இயல் topic and is also used in the classified expression இலக்கணப் போலி, supporting an internal grammatical concept of substitution/semblance rather than ordinary lexical use alone.
decisions.review_notes: The broad category other-grammar avoids over-narrowing a concept that appears in both letter-level and usage classification contexts.

decisions.rationale: Nannūl uses இலக்கணம் explicitly for grammar/rule formulation, contrasts இலக்கியம் with இலக்கணம், and employs the form in classifying usage as இலக்கணம் உடையது / இலக்கணப் போலி.
The plural exact form உருபுகள் is a source heading and appears in explicit descriptions of grammatical markers and particle classes, retaining the technical sense of உருபு in plural form.
decisions.review_notes: The plural surface remains independently addressable and is not silently merged with singular உருபு.

decisions.rationale: Nannūl explicitly names பொருள்கோள், states that there are eight types, and governs a dedicated 411–419 section describing methods by which textual order is construed for meaning.
இகர is used as the grammatical name of the i-vowel/இ-letter in ending and extension descriptions and occurs in the technical heading இகர வீற்றுச் சிறப்புவிதி.

The exact form சொல்லின் is a compositional genitive/oblique form of சொல் ('of the word/words') in both the reviewed body context and the heading சொல்லின் பொதுவிலக்கணம். The base grammatical term சொல் is already independently reviewed; the inflected relational surface does not need a separate term entry.
decisions.review_notes: Rejection does not deny that the governed heading is grammatical; it distinguishes term identity from an inflected syntactic form of the accepted term சொல்.

decisions.rationale: பிறப்பு is explicitly listed as an எழுத்து இயல் topic and heads the section explaining how differentiated letter sounds arise through articulatory effort and places of articulation.
decisions.review_notes: The governed definition uses பிறப்பே, while the exact candidate form occurs in the topic inventory at 57.

decisions.rationale: உருவம் is explicitly listed among the எழுத்து இயல் dimensions and receives a dedicated source heading governing the statement about letter shapes/forms and dot marking.
அகர names the அ-vowel/letter in an explicit morphophonological rule and appears in the technical heading அகர வீற்றுச் சிறப்புவிதி.

The exact bound form சிறப்புப் functions as the ordinary modifier 'special/specific' inside distinct technical compounds (சிறப்புப் பெயர்வினை, சிறப்புப் புணர்ச்சி). The evidence supports those compounds, not independent termhood for the modifier itself.
decisions.review_notes: This parallels the treatment of பொதுப்: technical compound membership alone does not create a standalone exact-form term.

decisions.rationale: ஒழிபு is used as named grammatical metalanguage in பொதுவியல் and is also the source heading for a dedicated வினையியல் residual/exceptional-rules section, supporting technical use without forcing a narrower modern category.
பெயரெச்சம் has a dedicated வினையியல் heading and definition and is used explicitly in the description of வினைத்தொகை, establishing a verbal/participial grammatical category.
decisions.review_notes: The governed definition at 340 uses the segmented form பெயரெச் சம்மே; the exact candidate occurs at 364.

decisions.rationale: Across widely distributed contexts, ஆகும் is the ordinary copular/resultative verbal form used to state that something becomes, is, or counts as something. Its high frequency reflects rule-statement syntax, not independent grammatical termhood.
decisions.review_notes: A technical rule may contain ஆகும் without making the copular form itself a terminology entry.

decisions.rationale: ஐ is explicitly used as a Tamil vowel/letter symbol in எழுத்து இயல் and also as the accusative/case-marker form in உருபு and வேற்றுமை descriptions. The same surface also occurs as the numeral five, so acceptance is context-bounded.
decisions.review_notes: Primary analytical category is the letter/vowel class; the ledger also preserves its distinct case-marker use.

decisions.rationale: Nannūl uses முதல் as grammatical metalanguage for initial/first position and in internal classifications such as முதல்–ஈறு–இடைநிலை and முதல்/ஈறு environments. It also has ordinary enumerative or relational uses, so the decision is context-bounded.

Although ஈர் frequently functions as the numeral 'two', Nannūl also explicitly lists and describes ஈர் as a verbal ending/viguti, including the second-person plural paradigm. Those internal morphological uses justify context-bounded acceptance.

என is used productively as a quotative/classifying particle throughout Nannūl and is explicitly treated within இடையியல், including the particle descriptions around நூற்பாக்கள் 424 and 428. Frequency is not the basis of acceptance; internal grammatical treatment is.

என் has several uses, but Nannūl explicitly lists it among விகுதி and first-person verbal ending forms. It also occurs as possessive/quotative lexical material, so only the documented morphological contexts are treated as technical for this category.
decisions.review_notes: Other grammatical uses such as interrogative/quotative constructions are retained as reviewed context without forcing them into the morphology category.

decisions.rationale: ஈறு is repeatedly used as explicit grammatical metalanguage for the final/ending position of letters, words, forms, and inflectional material, including the source topic inventory at நூற்பா 57 and numerous ending rules.

The reviewed occurrences use இரு primarily as the numeral 'two', as part of ordinary counting/classification syntax, or as the lexical imperative 'be'. No independent technical term identity is established for this exact surface form.

என்ப functions as an ordinary reportative/attributive verbal expression ('they say/call') that closes or supports definitions. Its recurrence is a stylistic feature of grammatical exposition rather than a standalone grammatical technical term.

ஆம் has ordinary copular/ordinal uses, but Nannūl also explicitly lists it among verbal endings/viguti and in the தன்மைப் பன்மை paradigm. It additionally appears in the இடையியல் asai-word inventory. These internal grammatical-form uses justify context-bounded acceptance.

The bound exact form ஈற்று is used consistently in technical descriptions of final/ending position across letter, word, case, and verbal contexts. It is retained independently from ஈறு because the exact surface itself is pervasive grammatical metalanguage.
decisions.review_notes: Accepted as a technical bound/attributive surface, not silently merged with ஈறு.

decisions.rationale: The exact surface இயல்பும் is compositional இயல்பு plus the additive/conjunctive உம். Even where இயல்பு is technical, the clitic-bearing surface does not require a separate terminology identity; the base form can be reviewed independently.
decisions.review_notes: Rejection concerns independent exact-form termhood, not whether இயல்பு itself is grammatical metalanguage.

decisions.rationale: இடை functions as grammatical shorthand for medial/intermediate position and, in several சொல்லதிகாரம் contexts, for the இடைச்சொல் class alongside உரி. It also has ordinary 'middle/between' uses, so acceptance is explicitly mixed-context.
decisions.review_notes: The broad category other-grammar avoids collapsing its positional and word-class shorthand senses.

decisions.rationale: The reviewed occurrences use ஆறு overwhelmingly as the numeral six, with one ordinary 'way/manner' sense. Technical grammatical inventories being counted to six do not make the numeral itself a terminology entry.

பொருள் is repeatedly used as grammatical/semantic metalanguage for meaning, referent, denotation, or the semantic content of a rule/expression, including word, case, and பொருள்கோள் discussions. The same form also has broader ordinary/philosophical senses.

என்று is a quotative/classifying particle used throughout Nannūl and is explicitly present in the இடையியல் enumeration/particle discussion. Its grammatical function is internally supported even when it also serves ordinary reported-speech syntax.
ஒற்று is used systematically as technical phonological/orthographic metalanguage for consonantal/pulli-letter material and consonant position, including அளவு, doubling, deletion, and புணர்ச்சி rules.

The exact surface இயல்பே is a predicative/emphatic inflection of இயல்பு used to state that a form or rule is natural/regular. The technical concept may reside in இயல்பு, but the inflected exact surface does not warrant a separate term identity.
decisions.review_notes: Rejection is about exact-form indexing only; the base form இயல்பு remains eligible for separate review.

decisions.rationale: ஒன்று functions as the numeral/quantifier 'one' or an ordinary indefinite/unity expression across the reviewed contexts. Its use in grammatical enumerations does not establish independent technical termhood.

ஆ is explicitly used as the long Tamil vowel/letter and in letter-initial/final rules. It also appears as a grammatical ending and interrogative/other form, so the phonological category is the primary analytical anchor rather than a claim of uniform sense.
decisions.review_notes: Multiple grammatical uses are retained; primary category is phonology-letter-class.

decisions.rationale: ன is repeatedly used as an exact Tamil consonant/letter symbol in letter classification, final-position, alternation, புணர்ச்சி, and case-related environments.
ள is repeatedly used as an exact Tamil consonant/letter symbol in classification, final-position, phonological alternation, and case/poetic environments.

உயிர்மெய் is explicit Tamil grammatical metalanguage for the consonant-vowel composite letter class and is used consistently in letter counts, formation, initial/final position, deletion, and புணர்ச்சி rules.
ஆய்தம் is explicitly treated as a Tamil letter/sound category, counted among சார்பெழுத்து and described in articulation, அளவு, புணர்ச்சி, and deletion rules.

இ is explicitly used as the Tamil short i-vowel/letter in letter classification, articulation, அளவு, and phonological rules. It also occurs as a verbal ending and demonstrative-related form, so acceptance is not a claim of one uniform grammatical sense.
decisions.review_notes: Primary category is the vowel/letter class; other grammatical uses remain contextually distinct.

decisions.rationale: ப is explicitly enumerated as a வல்லினம் consonant and repeatedly functions as a letter symbol in phonological environments. The same exact form also appears in verbal-ending/intermediate inventories, so acceptance is context-bounded rather than limited to one grammatical domain.
ல is explicitly enumerated as an இடையினம் consonant and is repeatedly treated as a letter/final consonant in phonological and case-related rules.

Nannūl explicitly organizes தன்மை, முன்னிலை, படர்க்கை as three grammatical person/deictic positions and repeatedly assigns pronouns and verbal endings to முன்னிலை. The form is therefore named grammatical metalanguage, not ordinary positional vocabulary in the reviewed contexts.

Across the reviewed contexts வழி functions compositionally as 'way/path/by or after a condition' inside grammatical statements. The surrounding rules are technical, but the exact surface does not operate as an independent grammatical term.
பிற consistently supplies the ordinary residual/other sense ('other, others, etc.') in lists and rules. It is not independently defined or classified as grammatical metalanguage.

ஏ is explicitly listed as a long vowel and is treated as a letter in articulatory and punarcci rules. Other reviewed contexts also use the same exact form as grammatical material in சாரியை/விளி/இடையியல் environments, so the technical scope is mixed.

ஆதி functions as the ordinary enumerative expression 'beginning with / and so on' across grammatical and non-grammatical classifications. The reviewed evidence does not support an independent technical-term identity.
இறுதி is repeatedly used as positional grammatical metalanguage for the final/end element of a word or expression, including final letters, final deletion/change, and sentence/poetic final position.
பிறவும் is the ordinary additive residual expression 'and others / and other such forms' used to leave enumerations open. It does not function as an independently classified grammatical term.

மூ is a numeral/combining form meaning three in the reviewed enumerations (three positions, three classes, three senses, etc.). Frequency inside grammatical inventories does not establish standalone technical termhood.
ஓ is explicitly listed as a long vowel and repeatedly functions as a letter in initial-position and punarcci rules. It also appears as grammatical material in இடைச்சொல் and விளி-related contexts.

Nannūl uses வினா explicitly for interrogative/question forms, classifies interrogative letters and words, distinguishes question functions, and lists வினா among grammatical semantic/particle functions.

The exact form அல் is explicitly listed among verbal endings/viguti and among சாரியை forms, while other contexts use ordinary negative/exclusion senses. It therefore has internally supported grammatical-form use but is not uniformly technical.
இவை is the ordinary demonstrative pronoun 'these' used to point back to previously enumerated grammatical material. Its discourse function does not require a separate grammatical-term identity.
ஓர் functions as the numeral/indefinite 'one/a certain' across the reviewed grammatical and ordinary classifications. It is not independently defined as technical metalanguage.

எனும் is a compositional quotative/attributive form meaning 'called/termed' that introduces names and lists. The already reviewed base quotative form என has its own grammatical evidence; this inflected surface does not require an independent term identity.

க is explicitly enumerated as a வல்லினம் consonant and repeatedly functions as a letter symbol in phonological environments. It also occurs in verbal-ending inventories, so the exact form has multiple grammatical uses.
த is explicitly enumerated as a வல்லினம் consonant and repeatedly functions as a letter symbol in phonological rules; it is also listed in grammatical ending/intermediate inventories.
ஞ is explicitly enumerated as a மெல்லினம் consonant and repeatedly treated as a letter in articulation, word-position, consonant-cluster, and punarcci rules.
ந is explicitly enumerated as a மெல்லினம் consonant and repeatedly treated as a letter in articulation, word-position, consonant-cluster, and punarcci rules.

அற்று is explicitly listed as a சாரியை and is used as a grammatical linking/formative element after particular pronoun/nominal forms. Other occurrences carry ordinary privative/residual senses, so acceptance is context-bounded.
Nannūl explicitly organizes தன்மை, முன்னிலை, படர்க்கை as the three grammatical person/deictic positions and systematically assigns nouns, pronouns, and finite verb forms to படர்க்கை.

பெயரே is a predicative/emphatic surface built from the independently meaningful grammatical base பெயர். The reviewed contexts repeatedly mean 'is/name/noun indeed' rather than establishing a separate technical category for the cliticized exact form.
decisions.review_notes: Rejection concerns independent exact-form termhood only; it does not reject the base grammatical term பெயர்.

decisions.rationale: Nannūl explicitly defines the five short vowels as குறில் and repeatedly uses the term in phonological quantity, consonant-cluster, punarcci, and single-letter word conditions.

வ is explicitly enumerated as an இடையினம் consonant and repeatedly treated as a letter in articulation, word-position, cluster, and punarcci rules. It also appears in tense/intermediate grammatical inventories.

ஆய் is explicitly listed among verbal endings and as one of the singular முன்னிலை imperative endings. Other occurrences use the same surface compositionally in the sense 'as/becoming', so acceptance is restricted to the documented morphological contexts.

இரண்டு is the ordinary numeral 'two' throughout the reviewed enumerations and rule counts. Its recurrence inside grammatical classifications does not establish an independent grammatical-term identity.

அ is explicitly one of the five குறில் vowels and is repeatedly handled as a letter in articulation and word-position rules. The exact form also occurs in விகுதி and சாரியை inventories, giving it additional grammatical-form uses.

ஈ is explicitly listed as a long vowel and is treated as a letter in articulation, word-final, punarcci, and case-form rules. The same surface also appears in grammatical asai/form inventories; ordinary lexical imperative use is kept separate.

சுட்டு is internally established as demonstrative/deictic grammatical metalanguage: Nannūl classifies சுட்டு letters/forms, uses it in punarcci rules, and lists it among nominal and rule-semantic categories.
இனம் functions as grammatical class/kind metalanguage across phonology and syntax/semantics, including homorganic letter classes, class-based alternation, and semantic/class relations.
பெயர்வினை repeatedly functions as a collective grammatical designation for noun-and-verb classes in word classification, inflection, syntactic distribution, and உரிச்சொல் rules.
ஏவல் is explicitly used for imperative verbal formation and imperative function, including ஏவல் வினை, derived imperative formation, imperative endings, and imperative speech acts.
எச்சம் is repeatedly used as grammatical metalanguage for residual/elliptic or dependent completion classes, including பெயர்/வினை எச்சம், construction inventories, and இடைச்சொல் meanings.

உருபே is a predicative/emphatic exact surface based on the independently accepted term உருபு. The reviewed passages assert that something 'is a உருபு'; they do not establish a distinct grammatical category named உருபே.
decisions.review_notes: Rejection concerns independent exact-form termhood only; the base term உருபு remains accepted.

decisions.rationale: அவற்றுள், is a punctuation-bearing discourse expression meaning 'among those'. It introduces sublists across sections but is not grammatical terminology.

தன் is primarily the ordinary reflexive/possessive form 'one's own' and, where cited as a word form, functions as lexical material subjected to a rule rather than as the name of a grammatical concept. It belongs more naturally in a later example/form index.

காலம் is explicitly grammaticalized as tense/time classification: Nannūl defines the three verbal times இறப்பு, எதிர்வு, நிகழ்வு, treats tense in verbal meaning, and identifies tense-hidden verbal compounds. Broader time senses remain compatible but do not erase this technical use.

அளவு has explicit phonological/quantitative use for sound duration and measure, including உயிர் அளவு and அளவு இறந்து இசைத்தல். Other occurrences mean ordinary extent/limit, so acceptance is context-bounded.
உ is explicitly one of the five குறில் vowels and is handled as a letter in articulation and word-position rules. The same exact form is also listed among சாரியை and case-related grammatical forms.
ற is explicitly enumerated as a வல்லினம் consonant and repeatedly manipulated as a letter in phonological rules. It also occurs in விகுதி, இடைநிலை, and finite-verb ending inventories.

இடம் is used as grammatical place/position metalanguage in more than one domain: place of articulation, semantic/location class, and the grammatical person/deictic dimension contrasted in வழு rules. The exact form is therefore technically meaningful despite ordinary locative overlap.

முன்னர் functions compositionally as the relational 'before/in front of' in phonological and morphological conditioning statements. It is rule language, not the name of an independent grammatical category.
மொழி repeatedly functions as metalinguistic 'word/expression' in technical positional and construction descriptions such as மொழி முதல், மொழி இடை, இறு மொழி, and அடைசேர் மொழி.
நான்கும் is the numeral four with additive/collective morphology ('all four/the four'), used to count members of grammatical inventories. It is not an independent technical term.
அகரம் is explicit letter-name metalanguage for the அ vowel and is repeatedly used to describe its insertion, deletion, change, and occurrence as an ending in morphological and case rules.
உம்மை is explicitly grammatical terminology for the உம் particle and its functions/constructions, including உம்மைத்தொகை, எச்ச உம்மை, particle meanings, and morphophonological treatment.
ஏற்கும் is the ordinary verbal form 'accepts/takes/can take' used to state compatibility or applicability of grammatical forms. It describes rule behavior rather than naming a grammatical category.
உயர்திணை is explicitly defined as a core nominal/semantic class, contrasted with அஃறிணை and subdivided into ஆண், பெண், பலர்; subsequent case and construction rules depend on this class.

சிறப்பு has explicit grammatical uses for particularizing/emphatic distinction, including சிறப்பு எழுத்து and the சிறப்பு semantic function of particles. The same surface also occurs as ordinary 'distinction/excellence', so acceptance is context-bounded.
